name: hypertabular
summary: Delimited text — CSV, TSV, any single-byte separator — and XLSX/ODS workbooks read a batch at a time into typed columns, with a HyperCast verdict for every cell. A PyO3 native extension linking a Rust core directly into CPython: the boundary is crossed once per batch, columns arrive as typed memoryviews rather than a call per cell, and no compiler is needed to install.
author: Brian Buvinghausen
